dedupe_keys.name: cadent gas pipe infrastructure gpi open low and medium pressure gas distribution pipes in cadent networks great britain

description: Gas Pipe Infrastructure - GPI Open is an open dataset from Cadent Gas Limited, a licensed gas transporter, showing the low pressure and medium pressure gas pipes it owns in all its distribution networks in Great Britain. The Opendatasoft listing holds about 2.28 million line records, each with geometry, pipe type, pressure tier, material, diameter and unit, carrier pipe material and diameter where a pipe is relined, asset id, depth, an above-ground indicator and installation date. The page says it replaces the earlier GPI Pipe Infrastructure Open dataset and follows the Gas Network Interoperable Data Standard, so it can be combined with data from other gas distribution networks. It is free under the Open Government Licence 3.0 through the Opendatasoft explorer, exports and API, and was last processed on 22 September 2026. Coverage is Cadent distribution areas. Caveats: pipes of other transporters or private owners are not shown, accuracy is not guaranteed, and it must not be used for digging, for which the page points to LSBUD. Simulation uses are gas distribution topology, material and age for network models and exposure of pipes to ground movement and flooding. Related records: data-gem-global-gas-infrastructure-tracker covers transmission pipelines worldwide.
